## Announce each new YouTube video with sprkly

### How it works
- Every 15 minutes it checks your channel's public feed for a new video.
- A new video becomes one post on your other accounts, 15 minutes later.
- The caption is the video's title and its link. The image is the video's thumbnail.
- External ID `yt-<video id>` means a video is never announced twice.
- You get a Telegram message with the time, or with what went wrong.

### Setup
- Needs the n8n-nodes-sprkly community node (Settings, Community Nodes).
- Add your sprkly API key to **Announce in sprkly**. API docs: https://sprkly.app/docs/api
- In **New video on your channel**, put your channel ID in place of YOUR_CHANNEL_ID. It starts with UC, and you find it in YouTube Studio under Settings, Channel, Advanced settings.
- In **Settings**, write your accounts as platform:handle, with commas between them. Leave YouTube out.
- Add your bot token to **Send result to Telegram**, and your chat ID in **Settings**.

### Customize
- Change the wording in **Announce in sprkly**.
- Use maxresdefault in place of hqdefault in the image link for a sharper image, when every video is HD.
- More: https://github.com/ahlanlhw/n8n-nodes-sprkly

## Announce the video
No YouTube login is needed. The feed is public. Instagram and TikTok need an image, so the thumbnail goes on every post.
